quota_insufficient: Not enough credits — check your usage or ask your admin
unauthorized: Your session expired — sign in again to continue
forbidden: You don't have access to this
upstream_error: The image didn't come out — your credits were refunded
pool_unavailable: We're a bit busy right now — try again in a minute
proxy_unreachable: The network looks unstable — check your connection and retry
task_not_found: This record has expired — start a new generation
task_state_conflict: That step already happened — refresh to see the latest
task_limit_exceeded: Too many images generating at once — wait or stop one
rate_limited: That was a bit fast — try again in a few seconds
validation_error: Something in the input needs adjusting
internal_error: Something went sideways — try again in a moment
network: Looks like you're offline — check your connection
unknown: Something went wrong — retry, or contact support if it persists
